content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for IIT Delhi Coordinator (Admin. HR) Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.
